main_measure.name: mean of (forecast/10) x (2-bar return minus coin mean 2-bar return)
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 confirms (with quintile check), t <= -2 rejects, with at least 200 cases

supporting_check.name: top minus bottom forecast quintile mean excess 2-bar return

decided_by: The main t is 2 or more with at least 200 cases and the top-minus-bottom quintile difference is above 0.
reading: The coin's mean 2-bar return is taken over all non-overlapping grid bars of all its windows, quintiles are cut on the forecast rank (ties by order), and the off-settlement situation is read from the recorded regime.
